**Coaching Note:**

When your opponent's king moves to an exposed square and you have loose rooks, look for checking sequences. Here, Rg1+ gives check and forces the Black king away from defending its rook on h4—in every variation, you capture it next. The lesson: after your opponent moves the king to an active square, checks often win material by separating the king from its defenders.
